title: Inside The Clo X Ykk Virtual Showroom At Titas 2025! 💥
description:
Step inside the CLO x YKK Virtual Showroom at TITAS 2025 and experience how we’re shaping the future of fashion through digital innovation! 🌟

We were thrilled to partner with YKK to bring their fastening products into the digital realm — showcased through an immersive 3D virtual showroom that connects creativity and technology.

🔗 Explore the CLO x YKK Virtual Showroom via CLO-SET:
https://style.clo-set.com/virtualshowroom/2179514/live

🌐 Discover the YKK Trims Library on CONNECT:
https://connect.clo-set.com/ko/portfolio/122663/collection/collections

Let’s keep co-creating the future of fashion — digitally, sustainably, and collaboratively. 💡

#FashionTech #CLO #YKK #VirtualShowroom
